@@info: Keys that exist in <en> but not in <cs>.
The values below are the en source text — replace them with cs translations.
You do not have to translate all of them; leave out what you are unsure about and open a PR.
A maintainer then runs 'npm run i18n:apply' to merge this file into messages/cs.json.
Anything still missing afterwards simply renders in en at runtime.
phone_selector_search_help_substring: Matches any part of the brand or device name.
phone_selector_search_help_brands: The search narrows down whatever you have selected from the brand list.
phone_selector_search_help_brands_cross_: However, brand filtering is not applied to results from other databases.
phone_selector_search_help_commas: Separate devices with commas to look up several at once.
phone_selector_search_help_cross_site: Results from other databases only list sites carrying every device you named.
phone_selector_search_help_alternatives: Separate different keywords with // to match any of them.
selection_list_download_all_hint: The average plus every sample, as a .zip
equalizer_filter_list_import_skipped: Skipped {count} filter line(s) that can’t be represented here, such as band-pass or notch filters.
equalizer_filter_list_graphic_eq_channel: Left out {count} left/right-only band(s): a Graphic EQ is one curve for both ears.
equalizer_autoeq_exact_match_hint: Fits the curve's full shape up to 20 kHz, as the graph shows it.
equalizer_autoeq_treble_safe_hint: Smooths the treble and places no filter above 10 kHz, where measurements shift with fit and anatomy.
equalizer_autoeq_fallback_notice: The turboEQ optimizer could not be loaded, so a slower fallback fitted these filters. The ‘Auto Apply’ feature has been disabled due to its low performance.
equalizer_autoeq_fallback_rejected_notic: The turboEQ optimizer couldn't fit these settings, so a slower fallback fitted these filters.
equalizer_autoeq_graphic_unavailable_not: AutoEQ for a graphic EQ needs the turboEQ optimizer, which couldn't load. Filters are unchanged.
equalizer_autoeq_graphic_rejected_notice: The turboEQ optimizer couldn't fit this preset's bands. Filters are unchanged.
equalizer_autoeq_auto_apply_hint: Re-runs AutoEQ whenever the curves or options change. Editing the filters turns it off.
equalizer_autoeq_auto_apply_stopped_edit: Auto-apply turned off because the filters were edited.
equalizer_autoeq_auto_apply_stopped_inpu: Auto-apply turned off because the device or target changed.
equalizer_autoeq_auto_apply_stopped_pres: Auto-apply turned off because the EQ preset changed.
equalizer_player_freq_select_hint: You can drag on the graph to set the range. EQ node cannot be modified while it's enabled.
equalizer_device_peq_transport_serial: USB Serial — for devices exposing a CDC / virtual COM interface (JDS Labs, Nothing, FiiO, and more), including Bluetooth serial ports.
average_button_hint: Average all visible measurements into a new curve
average_button_needs_two: Show at least two measurements to average
crosssite_search_truncated: Showing first {count} of {total} matches. Refine your search to narrow it down.
site_selector_unverified: This database was unreachable when the index was last built. The link may not work.
eq_constraint_select_title: EQ constraint — limit the bands to what a device or app accepts
eq_preamp_auto_reduced: Preamp auto-reduced to {value} dB to prevent clipping
eq_history_apply_a_title: Apply the A mode to live filters
eq_history_apply_b_title: Apply the B mode to live filters
eq_history_pick_a_first: Pick a history entry or bookmark below as A first
eq_history_pick_b_first: Pick a history entry or bookmark below as B first
eq_history_empty: No history yet — your filter edits will be logged here.
eq_history_bookmark_exists: Already bookmarked — rename or delete it in Bookmarks
eq_history_bookmark_full: This browser already keeps {count} bookmarks, the most it can. Delete one to add another.
eq_history_bookmarks_empty: No bookmarks yet — star a history entry to keep it.
eq_history_help_text: Your edits are logged in History. Star an entry to keep it in Bookmarks, which stay in this browser. Pick any two entries as A and B, then switch between them with the buttons above.
eq_history_help_graph: Show on graph draws the side that isn't playing as a dashed line. Add to graph, in an entry's menu, keeps an entry as a curve of its own.
eq_history_help_loudness: Match loudness plays the louder of A and B at the quieter one's level, so you compare tone rather than volume. It only affects the audio player on this page — not Device PEQ or the uniPEQ link — and stops as soon as you edit a band.
eq_channel_shared_hint: + {count} shared band(s) also apply to this channel.
eq_channel_device_peq_shared_only: Sent {count} shared band(s). This device has no per-channel EQ, so {skipped} left/right band(s) were skipped.
eq_constraint_load_failed: Couldn't load {label}. Check your connection and try again.
eq_constraint_draft_title: Unverified limits: not yet checked against the real device or app
eq_constraint_catalog_failed: The EQ database can't be reached. The built-in presets still work.
eq_constraint_past_max_bands: Past the {max}-band limit of {label}. Remove a band or change the constraint to edit it.
eq_constraint_type_violation: {label} doesn't accept this filter type here
eq_constraint_fit_title: Move every band onto the nearest values {label} accepts. Undoable.
equalizer_device_peq_choose_prompt: Several devices match. Pick the profile that fits yours.
equalizer_device_peq_unsupported: This device isn't in the EQ database.
equalizer_device_peq_guess_notice: Not in the EQ database: connected with an experimental compatible protocol, so the EQ limits are that protocol's.
equalizer_device_peq_group_notice: Not in the EQ database: connected with a compatible profile shared by several devices.
equalizer_device_peq_draft_notice: Not yet checked on a real device.
equalizer_device_peq_experimental: This device is connected with an experimental protocol.
equalizer_device_peq_eq_hint: The EQ preset saved on the device. Changing it applies to the device right away, and Read and Write use the selected preset.
equalizer_device_peq_eq_switch_hint: Turn the device's built-in EQ on or off. Its EQ settings stay saved in the device.
equalizer_device_peq_eq_switch_unknown: This device doesn't report whether its EQ is on. Use the switch to set it yourself.
equalizer_device_peq_preset_hint: Pick the preset to read and write. Picking one here doesn't change the preset the device plays.
equalizer_device_peq_unreachable: This device can only read and write the preset it's using. Switch the device to the preset you want first.
equalizer_device_peq_synced: The EQ shown matches the device.
equalizer_device_peq_unsynced: The EQ has changed since the last read or write.
equalizer_device_peq_auto_write_hint: Your EQ edits are written to the device automatically. Enabling this will first write the EQ settings to the device.
equalizer_device_peq_auto_paused: Auto-write paused: some EQ settings don't fit this device.
equalizer_device_peq_auto_stopped: Auto-write turned off because the last write failed.
equalizer_device_peq_read_title: Replace the band list with the device's EQ
equalizer_device_peq_write_title: Send the band list to the device
equalizer_device_peq_write_only: This device can be written to but not read back.
equalizer_device_peq_read_skipped: {count} band(s) use filter types the equalizer can't show and were left out.
equalizer_device_peq_status_written_off: Wrote {count} band(s). The device's EQ is off: pick a preset to hear them.
equalizer_device_peq_status_saved_reconn: Saved. The device restarts after saving; reconnect to carry on.
equalizer_device_peq_status_reconnect_ma: Couldn't find the device again. Plug it in and connect.
equalizer_device_peq_push_intro: The device can't hold this EQ exactly as shown. This is what it will get:
equalizer_device_peq_push_dropped: Band {band}: no slot left on the device, not sent
equalizer_device_peq_push_skipped_channe: {count} left/right-only band(s) not sent: the device has one EQ for both ears
equalizer_device_peq_push_clip_risk: These bands boost, and this device's level can't be lowered from here. Turn the volume down or reduce the boost to avoid clipping.
equalizer_device_peq_push_infeasible: Some bands still break one of the device's rules (band order or spacing), so it may reject them.
device_peq_error_timeout: The device didn't answer. Check the cable and try again.
device_peq_error_transport: Lost the connection to the device.
device_peq_error_bad_response: The device answered with something unexpected.
device_peq_error_unrepresentable: A value can't be sent to this device.
device_peq_error_generic: Something went wrong talking to the device.
link_start_hint: You can also edit this EQ together with uniPEQ, which writes it to the device connected there.
link_help_what: uniPEQ is a free app for Android and web browsers. It reads and writes the EQ built into many USB DACs, dongles, headphones and IEMs.
link_help_why: Linked, the EQ you build here against a measurement, by hand or with AutoEQ, is sent to the device connected with uniPEQ.
link_help_phone: It works on a Android phone alone: a phone's browser can't reach USB devices, but uniPEQ can.
link_waiting: Open uniPEQ and enter this code, or scan the QR code with the phone that has uniPEQ.
link_qr_label: QR code that opens uniPEQ and links it with this page
link_other_server: This site uses its own link server, so a code typed in uniPEQ won't find it. Scan the QR code, or use Open uniPEQ.
link_stalled: uniPEQ isn't answering. Open it on your phone.
link_read_only: uniPEQ takes no edits while its device reconnects.
link_read_only_no_device: Connect a device in uniPEQ to edit this EQ.
link_device_rejected: uniPEQ's device came with limits this page can't read, so Hardware EQ doesn't show it.
link_paused: uniPEQ was paused for {seconds} s by Android
link_ended_version_unipeq: uniPEQ is older than this site's link. Update uniPEQ to link.
link_ended_version_site: This site's link is older than uniPEQ's. The site needs a newer modernGraphTool.
link_ended_timeout: The link ended: uniPEQ stopped answering.
link_ended_replaced: uniPEQ linked with another page instead.
link_ended_room_full: Another app joined this code first.
link_ended_elsewhere: The link moved to another tab.
link_failed_start: The link couldn't start. Check your connection and try again.
link_start_title: Which EQ should the link use?
volume_warning_body: Changing a device's EQ or starting playback can cause a pop, a dropout or a sudden jump in loudness. Pause playback or turn the volume down before you go on.
volume_warning_body_unipeq: uniPEQ is about to change the EQ on {device}. A write can cause a pop, a dropout or a sudden jump in loudness, so pause playback or turn the volume down while you adjust the EQ.
link_start_body: uniPEQ has a different EQ ({count} band(s)). Pick the one both apps keep.
link_start_flattened: {count} switched-off band(s) will be sent as 0 dB bands.
link_start_dropped: {count} band(s) uniPEQ can't hold (left- or right-only, or a switched-off pass or notch) will be left out.
